gloss: minced meat cutlet; ground meat croquette

definitions.gloss: minced meat cutlet; ground meat croquette
definitions.explanation: A deep-fried breaded patty made from seasoned ground meat (usually beef, pork, or a mix), onions, and other ingredients. A popular item in Japanese home cooking and at butcher shops.

examples.japanese: メンチカツを{二|ふた}つください。
{肉屋|にくや}の{揚|あ}げたてメンチカツは{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: Freshly fried menchi-katsu from the butcher shop is the best.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}は{手作|てづく}りのメンチカツにしようと{思|おも}って、{挽肉|ひきにく}と{玉|たま}ねぎを{買|か}ってきた。
examples.english: I decided to make homemade menchi-katsu for dinner tonight, so I bought ground meat and onions.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
メンチカツ is a staple of Japanese yōshoku (Western-style) cuisine. It is commonly sold at butcher shops ({肉屋|にくや}) and {惣菜|そうざい} (deli) counters. The name comes from English "minced" + "cutlet."

SIMILAR FOODS:
- コロッケ (croquette — made with potato rather than meat)
- ハンバーグ (Hamburg steak — similar meat patty but not breaded or fried)
- とんかつ (pork cutlet — a whole cut of pork, not ground)
